title: Hitchhiking in the Baltic States
titleZh: 波罗的海国家的搭便车旅行
statementMd:
Leha and Noora decided to go on a trip in the Baltic States. As you know from the previous problem, Leha has lost his car on the parking of the restaurant. Unfortunately, requests to the watchman didn't helped hacker find the car, so friends decided to go hitchhiking.

In total, they intended to visit $*n*$ towns. However it turned out that sights in $*i*$-th town are open for visitors only on days from $*l*_{*i*}$ to $*r*_{*i*}$.

What to do? Leha proposed to choose for each town $*i*$ a day, when they will visit this town, i.e any integer $*x*_{*i*}$ in interval $[*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}]$. After that Noora choses some subsequence of towns $*id*_{1}, *id*_{2}, ..., *id*_{*k*}$, which friends are going to visit, that at first they are strictly increasing, i.e $*id*_{*i*} < *id*_{*i* + 1}$ is for all integers $*i*$ from $1$ to $*k* - 1$, but also the dates of the friends visits are strictly increasing, i.e $*x*_{*id*_{*i*}} < *x*_{*id*_{*i* + 1}}$ is true for all integers $*i*$ from $1$ to $*k* - 1$.

Please help Leha and Noora in choosing such $*x*_{*i*}$ for each town $*i*$, and such subsequence of towns $*id*_{1}, *id*_{2}, ..., *id*_{*k*}$, so that friends can visit maximal number of towns.

You may assume, that Leha and Noora can start the trip any day.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3·10^{5}$) denoting the number of towns Leha and Noora intended to visit.

Each line $*i*$ of the $*n*$ subsequent lines contains two integers $*l*_{*i*}$, $*r*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$, denoting that sights in $*i*$-th town are open for visitors on any day ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/234a500fa088fe2bc5c74b5225e9aeb734f26c45.png).

## Output

Print a single integer denoting the maximal number of towns, that Leha and Noora can visit.

## Note

Consider the first example.

Let's take this plan: let's visit the sight in the second town on the first day, in the third town on the third day and in the fifth town on the fourth. That's would be the optimal answer.
statementZhMd:
Leha 和 Noora 决定去波罗的海国家旅行。正如你在上一题中了解到的，Leha 把他的汽车丢在了餐厅的停车场。不幸的是，向看守人的询问也没能帮助这位黑客找到汽车，于是朋友们决定搭便车旅行。

他们原本打算总共参观 $*n*$ 个城镇。然而，他们发现第 $*i*$ 个城镇的景点只有在从 $*l*_{*i*}$ 到 $*r*_{*i*}$ 的日期内才对游客开放。

该怎么办呢？Leha 提议为每个城镇 $*i*$ 选择一个参观日期，即区间 $[*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}]$ 中的任意整数 $*x*_{*i*}$。之后，Noora 选择城镇的某个子序列 $*id*_{1}, *id*_{2}, ..., *id*_{*k*}$，朋友们将按照该顺序参观这些城镇。首先，这些城镇的编号必须严格递增，即对于从 $1$ 到 $*k* - 1$ 的所有整数 $*i*$，都满足 $*id*_{*i*} < *id*_{*i* + 1}$；同时，朋友们参观这些城镇的日期也必须严格递增，即对于从 $1$ 到 $*k* - 1$ 的所有整数 $*i*$，都满足 $*x*_{*id*_{*i*}} < *x*_{*id*_{*i* + 1}}$。

请帮助 Leha 和 Noora 为每个城镇 $*i*$ 选择这样的 $*x*_{*i*}$，并选择城镇子序列 $*id*_{1}, *id*_{2}, ..., *id*_{*k*}$，使得朋友们能够参观的城镇数量最大。

你可以假设 Leha 和 Noora 可以在任意一天开始旅行。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3·10^{5}$），表示 Leha 和 Noora 原计划参观的城镇数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数 $*l*_{*i*}$、$*r*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示第 $*i*$ 个城镇的景点在任意一天 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/234a500fa088fe2bc5c74b5225e9aeb734f26c45.png) 对游客开放。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示 Leha 和 Noora 能够参观的城镇数量的最大值。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。

可以采用如下计划：第一天参观第二个城镇的景点，第三天参观第三个城镇的景点，第四天参观第五个城镇的景点。这就是最优答案。
